title: Three-checker UNSAT certificate — unsat_contradiction.cnf
natural_language: The CNF formula {x, ¬x} (1 variable, 2 unit clauses) is unsatisfiable. Evidence: (1) CaDiCaL reports UNSAT with a DRAT proof; (2) drat-trim verifies the DRAT proof; (3) lrat-trim verifies an LRAT proof; (4) cake_lpr — a CakeML binary whose LRAT-checking logic is formally proven correct in HOL4 — accepts the LRAT proof, outputting 's VERIFIED UNSAT'. All three gates are fail-closed. cake_lpr's acceptance is the trust anchor; drat-trim and lrat-trim are corroboration.

formal_targets.checker_version: cake_lpr/a4323b2 — compiled from CakeML assembly; checker proven correct in HOL4
formal_targets.statement_text: The LRAT proof for CNF (sha256=a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2…) is a valid unsatisfiability certificate, verified by the HOL4-certified LPR checker cake_lpr.

checker_results.notes: UNSAT; DRAT and LRAT proofs written.
LRAT proof verified; exit 20 (DIMACS UNSAT convention)
Output: 's VERIFIED UNSAT'. Acceptance is a formal soundness guarantee, not a heuristic check.

metadata.notes: Trust anchor: cake_lpr (HOL4-verified). CaDiCaL is fully untrusted — a solver bug cannot produce a proof that cake_lpr accepts unless the formula is genuinely unsatisfiable.
